cpu_serving.failure_signature: Model endpoint unreachable during the one-shot preflight connection check

diagnosis.preflight_amplification: A single connection error permanently failed a seat even when the shared endpoint recovered immediately afterward.

red_green_matrix.red: Nine CPU-serving seats failed the one-shot shared-model preflight while the retained Multi-Agent workshop was running.
red_green_matrix.green_local: A failing regression test now requires bounded retry and fail-closed behavior for persistent failures.

red_green_matrix.red: The ability to admit CPU Serving 25 with Multi-Agent 25 retained had not been measured.
red_green_matrix.green_local: Placement retains the 20 percent headroom policy and whole-workshop affinity.
red_green_matrix.green_integration: The preview admitted all 25 seats to Arena with 67 safe seats available.
red_green_matrix.green_live: Arena created 14 CPU-serving sessions while all 25 Multi-Agent sessions remained ready; low utilization disproved resource exhaustion.

red_green_matrix.red: The full 50-participant functional and isolation matrices cannot run until all 50 seats are ready.
Sequential zero-residue reclaim is intentionally deferred until the retained functional matrix finishes or the recovery attempt is aborted.

proof_strategy.tdd: The transient failure was reproduced as a failing preflight unit test before implementing bounded retry.
proof_strategy.edd: This immutable RED manifest preserves order IDs, image and source identity, capacity, seat state, endpoint probes, node utilization, and the observed cross-component probe incident.
proof_strategy.cdd: The existing workshop retry contract must retain ready sessions and target only failed or interrupted seats.
proof_strategy.bdd: Given Multi-Agent 25 is retained, when CPU Serving 25 is ordered, then every seat must become ready without a transient shared-service error permanently failing a seat.
proof_strategy.cbt: Placement, workshop lifecycle, shared model endpoint, Showroom readiness, control plane, participant tests, and cleanup are scored independently.

rubric.reason: Only placement/capacity and the retained Multi-Agent readiness preconditions passed; CPU seat readiness, the 50-seat functional matrix, and cleanup remain unproven.

remediation.implementation: Retry transient preflight connection failures three times with bounded delay while preserving fail-closed behavior.
remediation.live_recovery: Deploy the tested backend, retry only failed or interrupted CPU-serving seats in the same workshop, then run the complete participant and cleanup matrices.
